Klasse User

java.lang.Object
de.hitec.nhplus.model.User
public class User extends Object
Represents a single application user (login account).

A User carries the credentials needed for authentication (a passwordHash together with its salt; the clear-text password is never stored), the role that controls access, and two status flags (active, mustChangePassword).

Single responsibility: this class is a pure data holder. It performs no hashing, no database access and no UI work — password security lives in PasswordUtil, persistence in UserDao.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • User

      public User(int id, String username, String passwordHash, String salt, String role, boolean active, boolean mustChangePassword)
      Creates a fully populated user, typically when mapping a database row.
      Parameter:
      id - technical primary key (0 for a not-yet-persisted user)
      username - unique login name
      passwordHash - salted hash of the password (never the clear text)
      salt - salt that was used to produce passwordHash
      role - role identifier, e.g. "ADMIN" or "PFLEGEKRAFT"
      active - whether the account may currently log in
      mustChangePassword - whether the user must set a new password on next login
